arguments.body:
Hi Tauhid,

I’m sorry, but the Classic Bulldog Tee in size S is currently out of stock, and I can’t yet give you a restock date. We’re arranging a restock and will follow up when we have an update. The tee is $28. Sizes M (5 in stock) and L (3 in stock) are available now if you’d prefer a nearby size. Would you like one of those, or would you rather wait for a restock update?

Campus Customs Customer Service
